Today, I decided to come to this clinic because a friend recommended it. The doctor has a very gentle hand, and all the staff were polite and gave me advice on how to take care of my mouth. I'd like to thank the doctor and all the staff for their attentive service and helpful advice.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรม สไมล์ไอเดีย
text:
My first dental visit was with a very gentle female dentist; it didn't hurt at all. I told her my budget was 1000 baht and asked how many fillings I could get (7 cavities). She recommended 2 fillings for 1200 baht, using tooth-colored filling (one surface) plus a 40 baht sterilization fee. Bank transfer is available if cash isn't convenient. The reception staff were helpful and efficient. They scheduled an appointment for a convenient date and called to remind me. There's parking in front of the clinic and it's near the Rama 5 market.

*Additional Note* After three visits to the clinic – two fillings and a scaling/fluoride treatment (800 baht) – the first two times were excellent. However, the last visit involved a very long wait despite having a pre-scheduled appointment. I'm not sure if there was a communication error or a confusing scheduling process, as they confirmed the time beforehand, but the appointment was an hour late.

P.S. Those with social security insurance can use it here, but a prepayment is required.
